name: Bendy and the Brine Barrel
summary: Bendy and the Brine Barrel, also known by it's filename "Pickle", is a joke survival horror game almost entirely paralleling Bendy and the Ink Machine's demo. It was released by "Joey Drew Pickle Inc" through Bendy: Secrets of the Machine via a QR code inside of the main room, leading to a subpage on the Bendy website that had the file for the game.
